Title: LSJ- which goes first?Form of mist or Fast reaction

Messages.Author: mads...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
What if Vamp A gets blocked and plays form of mist at superior, vamp C
(not the blocker) then plays fast reaction, which goes first? the
action at +1 stealth or the combat via Fast Reaction?

to make things more complex, what about if Vamp D plays hidden lurker?

Thanks

Sent via Deja.com
http://www.deja.com/

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
mads...@my-deja.com wrote:
> What if Vamp A gets blocked and plays form of mist at superior, vamp C
> (not the blocker) then plays fast reaction, which goes first? the
> action at +1 stealth or the combat via Fast Reaction?

Combat. (And the continuance of the action is nullified).

* Any effect that starts a new combat after the combat that was
ended by superior Form of Mist (or continues the combat that
was ended) will nullify the "continue action" effect. This
includes Psyche (superior), Fast Reaction, Hidden Lurker, and
Telepathic Tracking. [LSJ 19980109]

> to make things more complex, what about if Vamp D plays hidden lurker?

Same thing, assuming you mean "... instead of Vamp C playing
Fast Reaction."

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>So, can an acting vampire still "continue action", if he goes a second
>round and play Form Of The Mist while a third vampire (C) had played
>Fast Reaction on him?
>
>In case of a vampire(B) playing Hidden Lurker (action modifier), can
>this vampire play Form Of The Mist to continue the "current action"
>declared by the acting vampire(A)?

Yes you can continue the action if you play that card during the subsequent
combat. (First round you Majesty or Earth Meld, someone plays a TT/Fast
Reaction/ Hidden Lurker and then second round you Form of Mist to continue the
action). Note that if you play FoM during the first action and a second combat
begins, you can't play another FoM (since only one action modifier per action).

Halcyan 2
